name: MINERS JERKIN
desc: Leather and wool. It has crawled through every tunnel.

name: DWARVEN PLATE
desc: Forged under the mountain. It rings when struck.

name: MITHRIL COAT
desc: Light as cloth, hard as dragon scale.

name: IRON RING
desc: A miners ring. It keeps your pace.

name: FORGE SIGNET
desc: Forge fire sleeps in the stone. Every blow bites harder.

name: ENDLESS KNOT
desc: A dwarven knot with no end. You do not tire.

name: LODESTONE
desc: Pulls loose ore and coin to your hand.

name: STAR CRYSTAL
desc: A crystal from the deep. Splits a rune into a fan.

name: HEART OF THE MOUNTAIN
desc: The gem the halls were dug for.

name: MINERS PICK
desc: Dull for stone, sharp enough for orcs.

name: RUNE STAFF
desc: Iron staff cut with runes that glow in the dark.

name: LUCKY NUGGET
desc: The first gold you ever dug. Still lucky.

name: FELT BOOTS
desc: Soft felt over iron soles. The deep does not hear you.

name: DRUM STONE
desc: It hums when drums beat in the deep.
